abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.description: You send forth an ashy tendril reaching up to short range, inflicting 2 damage to a living target with a successful Intellect attack roll. You benefit from their drained life, healing a minor wound from yourself or an ally within immediate range. Action.

abilities.name: Tribulation
abilities.description: You conjure pure spiritual energy to blast up to five undead, demons, and creatures of similar ilk of level 2 or less within short range. If you succeed on a separate Intellect attack against each foe, you choose whether they spend their next turn fleeing or lose their next turn.

abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Increase the maximum level of the foe you can affect by 1. Specify some other action for the creatures to perform for one round, such as attacking a foe of your choice.

system.description:
A Dungeon Fantasy Type focused on necromancer archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Fantasy. Subgenre: Dungeon Fantasy. Primary Pools: intellect.
